name: Primary Immunodeficiency with Natural Killer Cell Deficiency and Adrenal Insufficiency
aliases: NK Cell Deficiency with Adrenal Insufficiency

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proposed Diagnostic Criteria for Primary Immunodeficiency with NK Cell Deficiency and Adrenal Insufficiency

criteria.description: Marked reduction or absence of natural killer (NK) cells in peripheral blood by flow cytometry
Clinical and biochemical evidence of primary adrenal insufficiency including low cortisol and elevated ACTH
History of recurrent viral and bacterial infections consistent with immunodeficiency
Presence of autoimmune phenomena such as autoimmune cytopenias
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes associated with NK cell development or adrenal function

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of NK cell deficiency, clinical adrenal insufficiency, and recurrent infections
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of secondary causes of adrenal insufficiency and NK cell depletion.

searchTerms: very low natural killer cell count
adrenal gland failure with darkened skin
low adrenal hormones with skin darkening

pathognomonic.symptomName: Recurrent severe viral infections, especially herpesviridae family

searchTerms: chronic yeast infections on skin and mucous

common.symptomName: Autoimmune cytopenias (e.g., autoimmune hemolytic anemia, thrombocytopenia)
searchTerms: blood cell destruction by immune system

common.symptomName: Hypoglycemic episodes due to adrenal insufficiency
Failure to thrive in infancy or early childhood
searchTerms: failure to gain weight or grow

common.symptomName: Chronic diarrhea secondary to infections or autoimmune enteropathy
searchTerms: chronic diarrhea due to immune problems
low blood sodium during adrenal crisis

occasional.symptomName: Chronic cough due to recurrent respiratory infections
searchTerms: ongoing cough from repeated lung infections

rare.symptomName: Neurological manifestations such as seizures secondary to hypoglycemia
searchTerms: seizures caused by low blood sugar
brain problems due to low glucose
eye problems including inflammation inside the eye
eye involvement with redness and pain

laboratory: Severe reduction or absence of CD16+/CD56+ NK cells on flow cytometry
Elevated plasma ACTH with low serum cortisol
Autoimmune markers such as positive direct Coombs test
Hypoglycemia and hyponatremia during adrenal crisis
imaging: Adrenal gland atrophy or calcifications on abdominal CT or MRI
Chest imaging showing recurrent pneumonia or bronchiectasis
other: Positive response to corticosteroid replacement therapy
Immunoglobulin levels may be normal or mildly decreased

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of chronic mucocutaneous candidiasis with hypoparathyroidism
Profound T and B cell deficiency in addition to NK cell defects
Early onset severe infections with failure to thrive
Absent thymic shadow on chest X-ray

redFlags: Recurrent severe viral infections refractory to standard treatment
Signs of adrenal crisis including hypotension and hypoglycemia
Progressive autoimmune cytopenias unresponsive to immunosuppression
references: Orange JS, et al. Natural killer cell deficiency. J Allergy Clin Immunol. 2011;128(6):1317-1329.
Miller ML, et al. Primary adrenal insufficiency in immunodeficiency syndromes. Endocrinol Metab Clin North Am. 2019;48(2):337-352.
Orphanet Report Series: Primary immunodeficiency with natural killer cell deficiency and adrenal insufficiency. ORPHA:75391.
